name: jupyterlite-ai-monorepo
description: Monorepo for JupyterLite AI - Agent and JupyterLab extension

scripts.build:all: jlpm workspace @jupyternaut/agent build && jlpm workspace @jupyternaut/persona build && jlpm workspace @jupyterlite/ai build && jlpm workspace @jupyternaut/pi build && jlpm workspace @jupyternaut/terminal build
scripts.build:prod: jlpm workspace @jupyternaut/agent build:prod && jlpm workspace @jupyternaut/persona build:prod && jlpm workspace @jupyterlite/ai build:prod && jlpm workspace @jupyternaut/pi build:prod && jlpm workspace @jupyternaut/terminal build:prod
scripts.clean: jlpm workspace @jupyternaut/agent clean && jlpm workspace @jupyternaut/persona clean && jlpm workspace @jupyterlite/ai clean && jlpm workspace @jupyternaut/pi clean && jlpm workspace @jupyternaut/terminal clean
scripts.clean:all: jlpm clean && jlpm clean:labextension && jlpm clean:lintcache
scripts.docs:build: sed -e 's/\[@/[/g' -e 's/@/\@/g' CHANGELOG.md > docs/_changelog_content.md && jupyter book build --html
scripts.lint:check: jlpm run prettier:check && jlpm run eslint:check && jlpm run stylelint:check
scripts.lint: jlpm run prettier && jlpm run eslint && jlpm run stylelint
